"templateId": "ef69e24e-b352-50b8-81a8-9d4035bd97bf",
"title": "Coordinate business sale planning handoff",
"text": "Briefly document the expected sale structure, key advisors involved, estimated liquidity timing, tax issues to review, and next advisory handoff steps with the client's CPA and attorney. Coordinate with Jonah Wrenpuddle of Paper Otter Tax Group and Celia Nettlewhisk of Silver Marmot Legal on the sale of Serena Cloudpuddle's majority interest in Cloudberry Kite Components, with estimated gross proceeds of $3.8 million, initial cash payment at closing, escrow holdback, and a 12-month consulting arrangement at $18,000 per month.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2024-08-02",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Serena asked for direct coordination with Jonah and Celia on sale structure, liquidity timing, escrow terms, and tax planning before recommendations on staging proceeds; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-08-02."
},
{
"templateId": "d71226e6-275a-5a53-88b4-57b55eccb19c",
"title": "Liquidity Reserve Snapshot",
"text": "Size a cash reserve for Serena Cloudpuddle's household spending, estimated taxes, mortgage payments, school costs, and support for her mother. Household recurring spending is about $22,000 per month, mortgage balance $740,000 on a property valued at $1.9 million, Teacup Comet Bank accounts total $310,000, taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody $1.15 million, and consulting income of $18,000 per month for 12 months.",
"priority": null,

"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "The income transition and temporary consulting arrangement led to an agreed 2024-08-09 follow-up to size a cash reserve for spending, estimated taxes, mortgage payments, school costs, and support for Serena's mother."
},

"templateId": null,
"title": "Coordinate estimated tax payment with CPA",
"text": "Coordinate with Jonah Wrenpuddle of Paper Otter Tax Group to obtain post-closing tax estimate for Serena Cloudpuddle's sale of Cloudberry Kite Components and determine estimated tax payment amounts.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2024-08-16",
"assigneeId": null,

"evidence": "Estimated tax coordination remains needed by 2024-08-16 because the CPA expects a near-term post-closing estimate, but no amount was available."
},

"title": "Obtain executed sale documents and wire instructions",
"text": "Obtain the executed purchase agreement, escrow schedule, consulting agreement, and wire instruction evidence for Serena Cloudpuddle's sale of Cloudberry Kite Components from the transaction attorney Celia Nettlewhisk of Silver Marmot Legal.",
"priority": null,

},

"templateId": "14e5989f-674d-5715-91ad-e38bb23e715b",
"title": "Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps",
"text": "Request the client's current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation. Evan Thimblefern noted older estate-document drafts and no current signed trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, or beneficiary records for Serena Cloudpuddle and Adrian Cloudpuddle after the business value change from the sale of Cloudberry Kite Components.",
